scope: targeted primary literature review, not exhaustive novelty proof

entries.title: Run Time Assured Reinforcement Learning for Six Degree-of-Freedom Spacecraft Inspection
entries.inspected: Open manuscript formulation and runtime-assurance sections, particularly section 3.2
entries.established: Spacecraft inspection combines learned control with an explicit runtime-assurance filter and multiple constraints.
entries.implication: A new spacecraft filtering method must be compared with a capable constraint-aware baseline; our old one-step screen is insufficient as the sole comparator.
entries.limit: Open manuscript obtained; publisher PDF unavailable; no assertion of identical versions. DOI checked against retained publisher-deposited metadata; current direct metadata retry returned HTTP 429.

entries.title: Combinatorial and Adaptive Stress Testing for Spacecraft Runtime Assured Neural Network Control Systems
entries.inspected: Retained Crossref title, authors, proceedings type and DOI; current public author/institution event record
entries.established: Published proceedings identity and its targeted-testing subject are verified.
entries.implication: No first-ever discovery of runtime-assurance failures is claimed. No comparison may infer absent capabilities from unavailable text.
entries.limit: Full text not obtained; publisher PDF HTTP 403, current Crossref retry HTTP 429; cached publisher-deposited metadata retained. No detailed method comparison performed.

entries.title: Robust Predictive Output-Feedback Safety Filter for Uncertain Nonlinear Control Systems
entries.inspected: Sections III-V; observer/error bounds, equations 12-18, assumptions and Theorem 1; official certification code
entries.established: Observer error bounds, predictive tubes and terminal/backup constructions already support constrained output-feedback safety.
entries.implication: Combining uncertainty, state estimation and predictive backup is established prior art; use a faithful robust baseline.
entries.limit: Numerical assumptions and implementation transfer require validation; official MATLAB code inspected but not executed.

entries.title: A predictive safety filter for learning-based control of constrained nonlinear dynamical systems
entries.inspected: PDF pages 4-6; Definition 3.1, Section 4, Assumption 4.2 and backup algorithms
entries.established: A safe terminal set and previously feasible backup plan support recursive protection beyond a nominal one-step test.
entries.implication: One-step acceptance cannot replace a justified backup/terminal obligation; that principle is established.
entries.limit: Probabilistic model-error and nominal formulations have different assumptions; do not conflate them with deterministic interval guarantees.

entries.title: Control Barrier Functions for Sampled-Data Systems with Input Delays
entries.inspected: Sections III-C and IV; Theorems 1-2, Corollary 1 and input-history algorithm
entries.established: Stored inputs, sampled-data reasoning and state-error enclosures can account for delayed command application.
entries.implication: Delay-history propagation and robust intersample constraints are not new contributions.
entries.limit: Initial safe delay interval and model/enclosure assumptions matter; integer-period delay formulation should not be misrepresented as arbitrary unknown latency.

entries.title: Verified Runtime Validation for Partially Observable Hybrid Systems
entries.inspected: Sections 3-5; fallback definition, Theorems 1-3 and sensor-uncertainty monitoring conditions
entries.established: Verified monitor implications already address uncertainty, actuator disturbance and recovery conditions.
entries.implication: Proving a generic monitor-to-safety implication or noting uncertain sensing is not novel.
entries.limit: Preservation relies on the stated model, invariant and recovery timing; no claim that the present code supplies those proofs.

entries.title: Eyes-Closed Safety Kernels: Safety of Autonomous Systems Under Loss of Observability
entries.inspected: Section II and II-A, PDF pages 4-5; reachable/avoid sets and execution assumptions
entries.established: Safety under loss of observations and finite blackout durations already has a differential-game/reachability formulation.
entries.implication: A blackout budget must offer a specific computational or evidential advance beyond existing safety kernels.
entries.limit: The inspected construction assumes instantaneous recognition of external observation loss and a stated dynamical decomposition; its capabilities cannot be reduced to a scalar stopping rule.

entries.title: The Oracle Problem in Software Testing: A Survey
entries.inspected: Section 2 definitions and introduction, PDF pages 1-4
entries.established: Oracle information, formal specifications and partial predicates already organize evaluation claims.
entries.implication: An executable schema or independent predicate is supporting verification practice, not a new general assurance theory.
entries.limit: Source supports conceptual distinctions; it does not validate this numerical evaluator.

entries.title: A Summary of the RPODU Lessons Learned from the DARPA Orbital Express Demonstration System Mission
entries.inspected: Title/author record and PDF page 17, abort and navigation account
entries.established: The mission used a preplanned separation corridor and a separately located safe-hold destination during an abort.
entries.implication: Abort geometry is mission-specific; the benchmark union cannot be asserted as an operational requirement.
entries.limit: No source endorsement of the benchmark dimensions, thrust limit or hold thresholds.

redistribution: No third-party full texts or code copies included in this public specification.
